image_description: A large, greyish-green common iguana resting on a rocky surface near water and green vegetation. The iguana is facing left, displaying a prominent dorsal crest, a large dewlap, and textured scales. Its limbs are visible, gripping the rock, and its tail extends towards the right side of the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly triangular and large relative to the body. A distinct, loose fold of skin (dewlap) is visible hanging from the throat area.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the tail shows lateral compression (flattened sides). Although the full length isn't visible, the proportion suggests it exceeds the body length, consistent with species anatomy.
